rows.text: Bad camera and useless fingerprint reader. The fingerprint reader doesn't work 75% of the time! I third to reconfigure the fingerprint settings several times but nothing works. And the camera doesn't take good pictures; the background is blurry. Returned.

I've had my finger pressed repeatedly on it until it finally locks me out. Your finger has to be oriented exactly parallel to the phone and pressed with just enough pressure for just the right amount of time. Finally, the Camera SUCKS. More often than not, my photos come out blurry. You can't just snap and trust the camera to focus like with an Apple product or like the Pixel. You have to babysit it until it does not say "the last photo may have come out blurry." If you press the shutter too long, it doesn't take a picture at all. It just tries to focus. Been disappointed by many photos that weren't clear or didn't take at all. Not keen on that. Are these worth the discounted price?

Blurry Front Camera and Couldn't Make or Receive Calls. After I received the product, I noticed the front camera was completely blurry. But due to other circumstances, I kept the phone because I figured a phone without a working front camera was better than no phone. After three months of using the phone, it stopped receiving calls and didn't let me call anyone. I tried taking my sim card out and blowing any dust particles out but it didn't work. I ordered a new phone from Samsung and moved my sim card over. I can call just fine now, so my sim card wasn't the issue. I'd recommend just buying from Samsung unless you have time to inspect the phone upon arrival and send it back if it has issues.
